title: Smoked Pork Shoulder With Marmalade Glaze
preamble:
This smoked shoulder is cooked with vegetables then glazed and baked in the oven.

1 smoked pork shoulder, 5 to 7 pounds

1 carrot, cut into chunks

1 large onion, cut into chunks

1 celery rib, cut into chunks
method: Put smoked shoulder, fat side up, in a large pot and cover with cold water.
Bring to a boil; add carrot, onion, celery, and bay leaf.
Cover and simmer for 2 1/2 to 3 hours. Remove meat from broth and remove the rind.
Set meat, fat side up, on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Score fat in a decorative diamond pattern.
Combine glaze ingredients, stirring until well blended.
Spread glaze over the scored surface.
Bake the smoked shoulder in a preheated 350°F/Gas Mark 4 oven for about 20 to 30 minutes.
